features.title: Less noise. More conversation.
features.description: Catch message spam, unwanted Discord invites, links, and the words you choose to block. Edited messages get checked, too.

features.title: Care, with a little more control.
features.description: Adjust racism, misogyny, and anti-trans hate filters separately, with five coverage levels, your own terms, exceptions, and a choice of action.

features.title: A warning before a breather.
features.description: Keep a warning history and choose when repeated warnings lead to a timeout. Staff stay in control with manual moderation commands.

features.title: A small choice. A new connection.
features.description: Offer reaction roles or persistent button and dropdown menus, with descriptions, choose-one groups, and selection limits.

features.title: Every server gets its own blend.
features.description: Use guided setup, adjust your server's rules in the web panel, choose exempt roles, and send moderation outcomes to a private staff log.

link.label: Take a look at the panel

features.title: A thoughtful first hello.
features.description: Choose account-age checks or manual review, collect rules agreement, and grant a Verified access role when your policy is met. Staff manage requests in Member review.

features.title: A quieter way to ask for help.
features.description: Send private reports and appeals, track your own requests, and receive optional private outcomes. Moderators get a dedicated desk with internal notes and separate member-facing responses.

features.title: Different channels. Different needs.
features.description: Choose trusted websites and channel rules, then simulate saved or unsaved settings with member roles, warning history, cooldowns, and clear outcome explanations.

features.title: A little breathing room.
features.description: Watch for join spikes and coordinated repeated messages. Exclude channels or categories, track active protection, extend or end timers, and restore prior settings.

features.title: Know what needs a little care.
features.description: Check moderation permissions, role placement, log channels, member events, and verification access setup, with clear steps for fixing issues.

features.title: A warm hello. Something to look forward to.
features.description: Customize welcome cards and schedule local-time announcements in a named timezone. Use a calendar, daily or weekly repeats, editing, pause/resume, and reviewed delivery recovery.

features.title: Good company, freshly brewed.
features.description: Design coffee cards, create Discord polls, and post from your own conversation prompt library. Each server chooses its café features.

features.title: See what needs attention. Know what changed.
features.description: Review waiting reports, verification requests, delivery issues, and server health. Managers can inspect settings history and preview a previous recipe before restoring it.

features.title: A private place to work things out.
features.description: Open private support rooms, let the team claim and close tickets, and request an optional text transcript retained for 30 days.

features.title: Give everyone something to look forward to.
features.description: Create Discord events with opt-in DM reminders and dedicated event roles that expire when the gathering ends.

features.title: Good ideas deserve a place to grow.
features.description: Submit ideas, vote with persistent buttons, and follow public staff updates from review through completion.

features.title: A table for your own little group.
features.description: Join a lobby to create a personal voice room. Set its name, size, and connection controls; empty rooms clean themselves up.

features.title: Helpful answers, ready when you need them.
features.description: Staff write searchable FAQ replies that members find with /faq and /tag. Keep common questions easy to answer.

features.title: A little birthday sweetness.
features.description: Members opt into greetings and an optional birthday role. Only month and day are stored, with celebrations following the server timezone.

features.title: Keep the lovely moments close.
features.description: Collect starred messages from approved public channels. Members can opt out and staff can remove highlights.

features.title: Your own familiar face at the café.
features.description: Create optional profile cards, thank helpful members, and collect staff-awarded community badges without message-count leveling.
